apps.name: Tray Folder
apps.idea: Quick access to a folder. Classic scenario, pop open Tray Folder, drag the file you need into the program you're working in!

apps.name: Tray Converter
apps.idea: A handy unit converter, available the instant you need to swap units, and gone when you've got your answer!

apps.name: Tray Battleship
apps.idea: The classic Battleship Puzzle always at hand for a quick puzzle break!

apps.name: Trdo
apps.idea: Find internet radio stations and play them with a click of an icon in the tray! Perfect for background music while you're working without having to keep the entire radio station's web page open

apps.name: Tray Do
apps.idea: Simple To-Do scratch space always at hand. Remembering a short list, simple task list for the day, no added fluff.

apps.name: TrayRadar
apps.idea: Quickly check NOAA weather radar from a small, efficient tray app!

apps.name: Tray Voice Notes
apps.idea: Capture your thoughts on the fly with a single click! One click to start a local recording and fully local transcription all in a tiny app!

apps.name: Traymote
apps.idea: Control your Roku with a tray app always a click away!

apps.name: tray-MdB
apps.idea: Search for details about movies in your tray without interrupting your workflow with Tray-MdB!

apps.name: Tray2048
apps.idea: Play the classic game 2048 in your tray for a nice quick break in your day.

apps.name: Traysky
apps.idea: Bluesky from your systray

apps.name: quick places
apps.idea: Quickly search for a nearby business, see their hours, website, and phone (with quick QR Code gen to jump to your phone to make the call) backed by top quality Google Maps data!

apps.name: TrayQr
apps.idea: Quickly make and read QR Codes all in your tray. Perfect little app for a job that needs a Quick Response.

apps.name: TraySport
apps.idea: Check in with the scores and games of your favorite sports teams right from your tray!

apps.name: Tray Clock
apps.idea: Timers, stopwatches, and world clocks, all in your tray oh my! Glanceable timer and stopwatch progress from the icon.

apps.name: TrayWiz
apps.idea: Control your Wiz lights that are on your local network with a beautiful and fun tray app!

apps.name: Mini Sweeper
apps.idea: Take a break with a classic 💣 clearing game right in your tray, Mini Sweeper! Careful to avoid 💥!

apps.name: traydog
apps.idea: keep an eye on network connectivity and process behavior, if anything seems off, traydog will let you know right away!

apps.name: Trayulator
apps.idea: Calculate numbers, in a tray app, written in Rust!

apps.name: Tray Casts
apps.idea: Keep your favorite podcasts a click away! Find shows, follow feeds, and pick up where you left off with playback controls right in your tray.

apps.name: Tray Random
apps.idea: Roll dice, make up names, emails, addresses and more, all one click away in your tray. Pin your favorites and copy the result in a snap!

apps.name: Tray Git
apps.idea: Every git repo in your source folder, one click from the taskbar! Open a terminal, open the folder, or jump to the remote, all from your tray.

apps.name: MiniInk
apps.idea: A quick sketch with the pen can help form a thought like nothing else. MiniInk is a stack of sticky notes in your tray that you can draw on and pop out, to externalize your thinking.
